summary: The recorded base reproduced the original 518.307x CPU pickle amplification. At the exact candidate commit, the original fixture measured 1.312x with owned per-slice storage. Independent non-contiguous feature and simple-split precomputed-embedding cases also eliminated retained parent storage. Accelerator slices remained views on the assigned gfx950 GPU.

tests.what_was_measured: Original fixture: 1,048,576 logical bytes, 543,484,451 pickle bytes, 518.307x; 2,048-byte slices retained 1,048,576-byte storage. Also recorded failing non-contiguous feature and simple precomputed-embedding controls. Imports resolved to the prepared checkout source.
Original fixture: 1.312x and exact owned slice storage. Non-contiguous feature: 1.322x with exact owned storage. Simple precomputed embeddings: parent storage eliminated for every slice.
Candidate regression suite: 9 passed, including CPU pickle/storage checks for feature, precomputed embeddings, and split metadata.
On AMD Instinct MI355X gfx950 with ROCm/HIP 7.2.26015, accelerator slice values matched an independent reference and the slice retained the parent storage pointer.

gpu_execution.evidence: reports/j-ba68279b661a/candidate-gpu.txt and gpu-arch.txt record execution on one AMD Instinct MI355X, gfx950:sramecc+:xnack-, with correct values and shared accelerator storage.

remaining_limitations: No full multimodal model, HTTP serving, production-size request, or model weights were exercised; the deterministic source-level split and pickle contract was tested directly.
The source report used NVIDIA H200/CUDA, while the available accelerator boundary check used one AMD Instinct MI355X/gfx950 GPU with ROCm 7.2.
No claims are made about model semantic accuracy, a different model architecture, or multi-node operation.
The candidate changed Python only, so no native rebuild was applicable.
